newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela finance minister says bank crisis over.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela finance minister says bank crisis over.

text.p: The massive financial sector crisis which started in 1994 and shook Venezuela's banks for over two years has finished, Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said Friday.
Matos said that given improvements in bank capitalization levels, the government had decided to lift the state of financial emergency declared in mid-1994.
"An overall analysis indicates that virtually all of the elements of the systematic crisis we experienced in 1994 have been overcome," Matos told a news conference.
The crisis, which started with the collapse of Banco Latino in January 1994, saw over half the commercial banking sector fall into state hands and cost the state over $10 billion.
The government is still trying to re-privatize several banks inherited during the crisis and liquidate others which could not be re-floated.
